subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Get ready for… (Pre A1 Starters) + Units 1–3 sounds review
outcomes: I can talk about a picture: Where's the bag? It's on the floor.
I can listen and colour school things.
I can hear first sounds and write short words.

tf.s: We can answer Where's the bag? with It's on the floor.
tf.why: Yes! It tells where the bag is.

tf.s: We ask Who's this? about a boy or a girl.
tf.why: Great! Who's this? is for people.

tf.s: Colour the bag red means make the bag red.
Fan, fish and nut all start with f.
tf.why: Nut starts with n. Fan and fish start with f.

tf.s: Olive and octopus both start with o.
tf.why: Well done! Both start with o.

tf.s: Teddy starts with the letter t.
On starts with the letter n.
What colour is it? asks where a thing is.
tf.why: What colour is it? asks about the colour.

tf.s: b – a – t makes the word bat.
A pencil case is a person.
tf.why: A pencil case is a thing. We keep pencils in it.

boxes.q: Where's the bag? (down on the floor)
boxes.why: It's on the floor tells where.

boxes.q: Odd one out: fan, fish, nut
boxes.why: Nut starts with n. The others start with f.

boxes.q: What's the first letter of on?
Which question asks about a colour?
boxes.why: What colour is it? asks for a colour.

boxes.q: Is it a girl or a boy? (a girl)

boxes.why: It's a pen answers What's this?

boxes.q: Why are olive and octopus the same?
boxes.why: Olive and octopus both start with o.

hunt.q: Odd one out: fan, fish, nut

mcq.q: Which word is a school thing?
mcq.why: We keep pencils in a pencil case.

mcq.q: Which question asks where a thing is?
What letter does octopus start with?
The pencil case is below the chair. Where's the pencil case?
The teacher says: Colour the ruler orange. What do you do?
o: Draw a ruler on the floor.
mcq.why: Listen for the thing and the colour.

mcq.q: Your partner points to a door in the picture. What's this?
mcq.why: It's a door answers What's this?

mcq.q: Odd one out: olive, octopus, fish, on
mcq.why: Fish starts with f. Olive and octopus start with o.

mcq.q: Which sentence tells about the picture?
o: The book is on the desk.
mcq.why: A sentence tells. The others are questions.

mcq.q: Which answer goes with What colour is it?
mcq.why: What colour is it? needs a colour.
